issues.description: Wrong page shown: Current URL is /dashboard but expected screen is the marketing landing page. The landing page (hero image, gold CTA, marketing copy) is not showing at all — instead the authenticated dashboard is rendered.
issues.root_cause: The route / (landing page) is either missing or the app is redirecting to /dashboard automatically. The landing page file apps/web/app/page.tsx may be redirecting authenticated users or the root route doesn't exist.

issues.description: Multiple React hydration errors: 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML' repeated 7 times plus full hydration failure causing client-side re-render. This is likely caused by dynamic date/time rendering (e.g., 'Good evening, Amelia.' greeting which changes based on time-of-day, or 'Thursday, April 16' date) being rendered on the server with a different value than the client.
issues.element: Dashboard greeting text and/or date display
issues.root_cause: In apps/web/app/dashboard/page.tsx, the greeting ('Good evening') and/or date ('Thursday, April 16') are computed at render time using new Date() or similar, which differs between SSR and client hydration.

issues.description: Failed to fetch RSC payload after Fast Refresh — browser fell back to full navigation. This is a dev-environment side effect of the hydration error causing a full re-render cycle.
issues.root_cause: Cascading effect of the hydration error. Fixing the hydration error (issue #2) should resolve this.

fixes.reason: Prevents SSR/client mismatch by returning a stable default on the server side, avoiding hydration error from time-dependent greeting.

fixes.old_str: const formattedDate = new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'long', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' });
fixes.reason: Moves dynamic date computation to client-side effect to prevent SSR/client HTML mismatch causing hydration errors.
